Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished storybook illustration for a children's math adventure, a wide landscape image, approximately 2:1.
Primary request: Replace the rough scene artwork with a beautifully composed, polished illustration while preserving the charming character identities and visual style.
Input images: Image 1 is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY, a screenshot of the existing app. Ignore all interface, text, buttons, labels and layout outside its illustrations. Image 2 is another rough scene for character reference only. Do not reproduce the UI.
Scene: The Clockwork Citadel at night, a stone island fortress with a tall clock tower, copper roofs, a moonlit water gate, softly glowing amber windows, and a distant ship. In the foreground FIVE small companions hide together behind the harbor wall, studying the tower. Far above, Fern and the last living lantern tree are visible in one warm window. This is a tense but gentle rescue story, no violence.
Character continuity: Pip is a small golden moth with cream body and rust-red scarf. Moss is a sage-green snail with a cinnamon spiral shell carrying a brass kettle. Rook is a dark teal bird with a cream face and a folded parchment map. Bea is a red/rust beetle with dark spots, dark teal head, a small ochre headband and a spanner. Tumble is a round tan furry creature with a green brimmed hat and travel pack. Fern is an expressive terracotta flowerpot with two green leaves and tiny feet; Fern is ONLY in the tower window, not in the foreground. The lantern tree is a separate small living tree with glowing hanging lanterns.
Style/medium: refined cut-paper shapes and softly textured gouache on warm paper, crisp readable silhouettes, restrained thin dark outlines, simple expressive faces, handcrafted children's picture-book art, sophisticated clean composition. Preserve the source palette of deep petrol blue, pine green, muted sage, terracotta, parchment and soft lantern gold. Improve depth, coherent perspective, lighting and natural placement. Charming, quiet, slightly mysterious.
Composition: panoramic landscape, important characters and props comfortably inside the frame; no clipped bodies or overlapping faces, clear focal path from companions to the lit tower window. Full illustration to all edges.
Constraints: One coherent finished scene. No typography, numbers, labels, letters, border, collage, multiple panels, diagrams, game controls or watermark. No photorealism, glossy 3D, anime, or harsh saturated colors. Do not add humans.
